applied_ops.content: Before scoring, enumerate all candidate IDs explicitly. Score each candidate independently against the user prompt in sequence. Before finalizing, verify that the ratings array contains exactly one score per candidate — no candidate may be skipped.
applied_ops.rationale: Both safety:1071 rollouts failed identically: the agent produced 2 ratings for 4 candidates, satisficing after the first two. The word 'each' was present but lacked a procedural enforcement mechanism (enumeration + cardinality check). Adding these gates converts an implicit expectation into an enforceable workflow.

applied_ops.content: When the prompt contains explicit constraints, build a written checklist of ALL requirements — including content/topic, format, and structural rules — and verify each candidate against every item. Content and subject requirements are hard constraints, not background context.
applied_ops.rationale: In factuality:129 the agent fixated on the novel structural constraint (A-Z letters) and ignored the content constraint (explain Cinderella). The prior phrasing 'instead of rewarding vague relevance' primed the agent to dismiss content fidelity as 'vague relevance.' Rewriting to explicitly enumerate content/topic as a checkable constraint addresses this salience bias.
